notes: Method limits: WebFetch failed with DNS errors on every host, and direct curl to pexels.com was refused by the egress proxy (403). Every lead comes from search-engine index snippets. Nothing was opened, downloaded or screenshotted. Resolution, duration, owner and price appear only where a snippet stated them; everything else is 'unknown'.

The shared limit of 200 web searches per turn ran out before searches for the Rolls-Royce starlight headliner, umbrella-in-door and interior detail clips were finished. Those specific shots are still open. A follow-up run could search Shutterstock, Pond5 and Storyblocks for 'Rolls-Royce starlight', 'Rolls-Royce umbrella door' and 'Rolls-Royce Ghost interior'.

Licence summary. Pexels and Pixabay: free for commercial use, no attribution needed, but they do not clear trademarks (Rolls-Royce badge and Spirit of Ecstasy) or the rights of identifiable people. Mixkit: free licence. Videvo: varies by clip; CC BY 3.0 clips need a credit. Storyblocks: subscription. Getty, iStock, Shutterstock, Adobe Stock, Pond5: royalty-free licence for each clip, with creative and editorial clips mixed. Editorial clips (several Rolls-Royce and Brigade Road items) cannot be used for commercial or advertising purposes. Rolls-Royce PressClub and BMW Group PressClub films are labelled editorial use only. Intel newsroom B-roll is free for editorial use with the credit 'Intel Corporation'.
Prices found: Pond5 MG Road metro exterior HD $39; Pond5 MG Road metro time-lapse HD $119; Getty Commercial Street still $375 RF. No other prices appeared in the results.

Pond5 Brigade Road items 144840366 ('Night shopping in brigade road Bangalore') and 1090666 ('Busy Brigade road (Main Shopping Street)') were seen only as IDs without their URL slugs. Search those IDs on Pond5; their URLs were not guessed.
Getty's 'India 1982, 1980s Bangalore Cityscape View' clip (about 51 s) carries a conflicting nearby caption ('New Delhi, India, May 1982'). Check the location before using it as Bengaluru.

No Commercial Street video, no clip clearly showing a Maruti Omni in motion, and no Intel Bengaluru B-roll turned up. For 1990s and Omni-era material, the best leads are Wilderness Films India Ltd (claims 150,000+ hours of South Asia footage, including Digital Betacam-era material, licensed direct), Prasar Bharati / Doordarshan archives, Films Division (NFDC), and Maruti Suzuki corporate communications for 1983-90s plant and product film.

No Reuters, AP or AFP wire video of Ramesh Babu turned up, and reuters.com and apimages.com could not be searched by this tool. British Pathé hosts the Reuters historical collection, but its India material ends around 1984. Searching Reuters Connect, AP Archive and ANI directly is recommended.

Ramesh Babu YouTube leads: no view counts or channel names could be read, so all are recorded as unknown. The OMG India segment is HistoryTV18 programming, which A+E Networks TV18 probably owns. The TEDx talk would need TED permission for commercial or edited use.

Background from articles, to use in the scripts and not as footage: took over his late father's salon (various accounts say 1989 or the 1990s); bought a Maruti Omni in 1993-94 and rented it out; bought a Rolls-Royce Ghost in 2011 for about Rs 3.1 crore, with heavy taxes that nearly bankrupted him; fleet reported at 200 (2014), 378 (2017) and 400-500 (2018); runs Ramesh Tours & Travels; still charges about Rs 100 per haircut. Sources: yourstory.com/2014/04/barber-rolls-royce-ramesh-babu/, rushlane.com/indian-barber-luxury-cars-12235294.html, thebetterindia.com/90491/ramesh-babu-billionaire-barber, onmanorama.com/news/business/2018/07/30/hairdresser-who-owns-500-cars.html, analyticsinsight.net, cartoq.com. The fleet figures conflict between sources, and 'billionaire' is unverified marketing language.

Both the USA (English) and Bangladesh (Bangla) cuts can use the same B-roll, since none of these clips depend on language. Avoid clips with burned-in English captions or watermarks so the Bangla version stays clean. Vertical clips (for example Pexels 30225108) suit Shorts and Reels.
